description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright API documentation, including functions to create markdown links for classes, members, and parameters, as well as rendering links within documentation content.

methods.name: createMarkdownLink
methods.description: Generates a markdown link to a specific class member or event in the Playwright documentation based on language path, member details, and optional parameter or option.

methods.name: createClassMarkdownLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link to a class in the Playwright documentation.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates documentation links for classes, members, parameters, and options based on language and output type.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation path segments.

methods.name: formatClassName
methods.description: Formats class names for assertions based on the target programming language.

methods.name: assertionArgument
methods.description: Provides the argument name for different assertion classes.

methods.name: renderJSSignature
methods.description: Renders a JavaScript function signature string from an array of argument objects.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content to point to the Playwright documentation URLs.
